correctness.rationale: The determinant sum gives the unnormalized volume. Uniform conditioning leaves the sine pair kernel g(t)=sqrt(1-t^2)/2-pi/8 and a bounded canonical cubic kernel. Under the row tilt, a two-index overlap in the cubic sum inserts one tilt factor in each conditional projection, and a one-index overlap inserts two; the variance bound O(n^3+n^4 epsilon^2+n^5 epsilon^4) is valid. It is negligible at both stated scales. Independent checks of the normalized Funk–Hecke integral, addition theorem and Parseval give degree-2m eigenvalue -a_m with multiplicity 4m+1, trace sum pi/8 and quadratic sum 1/6-pi^2/64. The degree-two zonal coordinate has exact mean epsilon/sqrt(5), all other positive-degree means vanish, and for every finite set of coordinates the row covariance tends to the identity by uniform convergence of the density and harmonic orthonormality. The infinite spectral tail is canonical under every row since it excludes degrees zero and two, so its scaled L2 norm tends uniformly to zero with the cutoff. The blocks, including the noncentral one, are independent in the limit. Trace summability gives almost-sure and L1 convergence; a finite set of chi-squares can all be small independently of the small-expected nonnegative tail, yielding the exact upper support edge. The degree-two projection under the row law has coefficient -a_1 epsilon; after dividing by n^(5/2)|epsilon| the remaining bounded canonical terms vanish and the one-coordinate triangular CLT gives a_1^2/5=pi^2/20480. Both signs and the exact row centering are consistent. The verifier was inspected, not executed; numerical quadrature is not the proof. No finite-sample support, arbitrary-mode or rate claim is verified.

evidence: Under uniformity the prior cubic residual H_n/n^2 tends to zero in L2. The tilted product likelihood ratio against uniformity has second moment (1+epsilon_n^2/5)^n=O(1) in the critical window, so H_n/n^2 still tends to zero in probability. The canonical cubic mean is O(n^3 |epsilon_n|^3) by expanding the three density factors and using degeneracy in each slot. Exact row centering therefore does not alter this remainder. The pair mean is -binom(n,2)a_1 epsilon_n^2/5, yielding the exact chi-square centering as n grows. The upper edge and variance are direct consequences of the existing weighted independent-block law with these signs and center.

In the larger-tilt regime, expand the first row projection of h by integrating (1+epsilon P_2) in its two other slots. Its centered linear term is -2a_1 epsilon(P_2- epsilon/5), with uniform O(epsilon^2) remainder, from the already known pair spectrum. Hoeffding orders two and three under the actual row law together have variance O(n^4) for the unnormalized volume sum, since the kernels are bounded and canonical. The bounded independent-sum CLT with binom(n-1,2) multiplicity then gives the stated variance and scale without any new asymptotic device.

originality.rationale: The main critical-window law is a covered specialization. García-Portugués–Paindaveine–Verdebout's Theorem 4(ii) already gives the entire infinite weighted chi-square law with exactly its first active even sector noncentral. The prior isotropic zonotope record supplies the very same spectral weights and the order-three-to-order-two geometric reduction at the null. The reduction transfers at the critical scale by elementary likelihood-ratio contiguity and deterministic centering; it does not need the stronger moving-law remainder estimate to imply the headline limit. The standardized Gaussian for larger vanishing tilts is not stated by Theorem 4(iii), which gives consistency, but follows by the usual first-projection CLT with the already known degree-two eigenvalue. No mathematical error is inferred from the prior coverage.
residual_risks: Giné's 1975 original was located bibliographically but its open full text was not retrieved independently; no absence claim is made about that paper. The coverage conclusion uses the accessible explicit later theorem.

No earlier literal statement of the centered supercritical V3 CLT was identified; its rejection as a standalone remainder is based on the routine projection argument, not a claim of identical wording or publication.
